name: effort-router
description: Classifies each message as discussion or implementation, sets the main model's effort (and optionally its model) to match, and routes implementation to an implementer agent.

chat_effort.title: Chat effort
chat_effort.description: Effort of the main loop on a discussion message.

impl_effort.title: Implementation effort
impl_effort.description: Effort of the main loop on an implementation message.

chat_model.title: Chat model
chat_model.description: Model of the main loop on a discussion message: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full id. Empty keeps the session's model. A model that changes between messages loses the prompt cache.

impl_model.title: Implementation model
impl_model.description: Model of the main loop on an implementation message: an alias or a full id. Empty keeps the session's model. A model that changes between messages loses the prompt cache.

routed_model.title: Routed session model
routed_model.description: Only a session whose model id contains this text is routed. Empty routes every model.

classifier_model.title: Classifier model
classifier_model.description: Model that decides chat or impl for each message: an alias or a full id.

classifier_timeout_ms.title: Classifier timeout (ms)
classifier_timeout_ms.description: How long the classifier may take before the mode in force is kept.

classifier_min_confidence.title: Classifier minimum confidence
classifier_min_confidence.description: Confidence from 0 to 1 the classifier must give its answer for the mode to change. An answer below it keeps the mode in force; 0 accepts every answer.

delegate.title: Delegate implementation
delegate.description: On an implementation message, tell the main model to hand the code changes to the implementer agent. Off: only the effort and model change.

implementer_model.title: Implementer model
implementer_model.description: Model of the implementer agent: an alias or a full id.

implementer_effort.title: Implementer effort
implementer_effort.description: Default effort of the implementer agent; the main model may pass another on a call.
